label: IFRS Global Enterprise Extension Layer
description: Optional IFRS-oriented extension accounts for common enterprise, manufacturing, SaaS and management-reporting needs. Apply only after reviewing fit with the core baseline.

metadata.intendedUse: Optional child accounts layered onto the IFRS Global Core Chart of Accounts for additional operational detail.

members.name: Work in progress inventories
members.description: IFRS account 1165 (Work in progress inventories) is used under parent account code 1160 to recognize and monitor this balance area in the financial position. It normally carries a debit balance. Primary reference: IAS 2 inventories. Classification focus: current, extension.

members.name: Finished goods inventories
members.description: IFRS account 1166 (Finished goods inventories) is used under parent account code 1160 to recognize and monitor this balance area in the financial position. It normally carries a debit balance. Primary reference: IAS 2 inventories. Classification focus: current, extension.

members.name: Inventory obsolescence allowance
members.description: IFRS account 1167 (Inventory obsolescence allowance) is used under parent account code 1160 to recognize and monitor this balance area in the financial position. It is a contra account and normally carries the opposite balance to the related base account. Primary reference: IAS 2 net realisable value. Classification focus: current, extension.
